title: Title
description: SnapServe AI — The voice AI that never forgets. Build and deploy Indian-language voice agents with cross-call persistent memory, no code required.

title: The Team
description: Karthikeyan (CEO) + Gopi N (COO). WHY US: 12+ months running live voice AI for insurers in production — built SnapServe because no existing tool solved it.

title: The Problem
description: India's $40B+ BPM industry — every AI call starts from scratch, US-hosted tools don't understand India, memory loss = revenue loss.

title: The Solution
description: Memory · Language · Compliance. 2–3× cost advantage at ₹5/min AI vs ₹8–₹15/min human agent. Product ready and live in production.

title: The Memory Proxy
description: Distribution moat: one config line points Vapi/Bolna/Retell customers at SnapServe. Memory layer compounds inside competitors' ecosystems.

title: Voice AI Agents
description: LIVE TODAY. Embedded voice AI that hears, remembers, and completes customer workflows — no redirect, DPDP/IRDAI compliant.

title: Traction
description: Platform live. Pilots running. ₹0 → first paid MRR target Q1. Insurance pilot quote. Memory working end-to-end.

title: How It Works
description: 3 steps: Describe agent → Platform auto-configures with TRAI/DPDP guardrails → Live in < 5 minutes.

title: Market Opportunity
description: TAM $35.2B / SAM ₹600 Cr/yr (bottom-up: ~2,000 Indian co's at ₹3L/month) / Beachhead BFSI.

title: Business Model
description: Standard ₹5/min all-in · BYOP subscription only · Enterprise volume reduction. 2–3× cost advantage vs human agents.

title: Competition & Advantage
description: 9-capability comparison: SnapServe vs Vapi/Retell/Bolna vs Status Quo. Memory moat: history that compounds and can't be copied.

title: Roadmap & Milestones
description: TODAY / +12 MONTHS / +2 YEARS / +5 YEARS. Live in production, pilots running, scaling to ₹100 Cr ARR.

title: Financials & The Ask
description: Raising ₹3 Crore pre-seed. 45% Tech, 30% GTM, 15% Team, 10% Ops. 18-month milestones.

title: Annexure 1 — Tech Stack
description: TypeScript orchestration, decoupled provider-agnostic architecture, dynamic provider selection with automatic failover.

title: Annexure 2 — Memory Layer
description: Provider-independent context layer, fact & commitment extraction after every call, OpenAI-compatible Memory Proxy API.

title: Annexure 3 — Compliance Matrix
description: TRAI (DND, call hours, caller ID), DPDP (consent, encryption, erasure), IRDAI (disclosure, misselling prevention). CTA: snapserve.ai
